text:
```yaml
name: ADR Agent Review

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  adr-agent:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Run ADR Generator Agent
        uses: github/copilot-action@v1
        with:
          agent: adr-generator
          persona: .github/agents/adr-generator.agent.md
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
